title: Implement Student Payment System: Admin manual input, payments to Bank, overdue = Piutang
completion_summary: Implemented student payment system: admin manual input, payments to Bank account, overdue → Piutang tracking
acceptance_criteria: Admin can manually input student payments
Payments automatically go to Bank account (not Kas)
Overdue payments (past due date) automatically marked as Piutang
Piutang tracking shows all outstanding student debts
